content.text:
I built the part as an impeller and exported it to `submission.step`. The STEP file reads back as a single valid solid. Its silhouettes match the four reference views with a mean IoU of 0.982, between 0.981 and 0.983 per view.

It's a 100 mm diameter disc, 20 mm thick, lying on the X axis. The solid back face points to −X and the open side to +X. It has:
- a solid back plate with a Ø8 bore that goes all the way through
- a hollow inside Ø80, covered on the +X side by a front plate with a Ø64 opening
- a shallow groove around the outer edge
- a central hub of Ø22
- 6 straight blades running out from the hub to the outer wall

The IoU score only checks the outline, so it says little about the parts you can only see through the front opening. I estimated the hub size, the number of blades and their thickness from the images. The real part may differ there, for example 8 thinner blades instead of 6. That could cost some of the volume score, which compares the whole solid.

I built the solid with a script, so it has no editable feature tree. That's fine for STEP output.
